def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    rs=[r for r,c in pts]; cs=[c for r,c in pts]
    a,b=min(rs),max(rs); x,y=min(cs),max(cs)
    for c in range(x,y+1):
        if out[a][c]==1: out[a][c]=2
        if out[b][c]==1: out[b][c]=2
    for r in range(a,b+1):
        if out[r][x]==1: out[r][x]=2
        if out[r][y]==1: out[r][y]=2
    return out
